Maria Chen: Heads up — prod prefix cache hit-rate dropped ~12% since runtime v2.14. Suspect tokenizer bump (3.1.2) + small system prompt change that added tool metadata. Dumping quick findings.

Kevin Patel: dashboard link?

Maria Chen: https://grafana.internal/redwood/cache/prefix-hit?from=now-24h :eyes:
Numbers: pre-release 24h hit=78.3%  (ts 1781150000), post-release 24h hit=66.4% (ts 1781230000). p50 latency +8%.

Maria Chen: I pulled a few sample cache key inputs — notice extra tool JSON and inconsistent whitespace/quotes altering keys.

Sample (before):
```
prompt = "System: assistant helpful\nUser: Hello"
key = sha1(normalize(prompt) + tokenizer_version)
# -> sha1("system:assistant helpful\nuser: hello|tok=3.1.1")
```

Sample (after):
```
prompt = "System: assistant helpful\nUser: Hello\nTools:[{\"name\":\"search\",\"params\":{}}]"
# -> sha1("system:assistant helpful\nuser: hello\ntools:[...]|tok=3.1.2")
```

Sasha Ortiz: Two quick ideas: 1) canonicalize prompts for prefix-keying: strip tool/function call payloads and non-deterministic metadata; collapse unicode & whitespace; 2) include tokenizer fingerprint (hash of vocab+merges) in key, not just version string.

Anika Roy: Also hit a subtle one — the tokenizer library changed how it emits special tokens (different casing for <|tool_call|>) so token id streams changed even for same raw text. Fingerprint + pinning avoids that.

Kevin Patel: runtime profile attached showed KV cache hit drop concentrated on prefixes >64 tokens. Could be tokenizer splitting causing different prefix boundaries. Also slight bump in cache key cardinality.

runtime-bot: perf/kv-profile summary: prefix-hr by len: 0-16=85% -> 83%, 17-64=72% -> 69%, 65-256=66% -> 49% (big drop). Most variance due to added trailing tool metadata in system prompt for multimodal route.

Sasha Ortiz: We should add a canonicalization layer that has three modes: strict (no changes), lenient (strip tool fields, normalize whitespace), and token-aware (normalize to token ids). Start with lenient for safety.

Maria Chen: I'll open PR with canonicalizer util + tests. Plan: normalize JSON fields (sort keys, drop fields listed in config like "tool_payload", collapse whitespace, unicode NFKC), and add tokenizer_fingerprint into key.

Kevin Patel: Add metrics: cache_key_variants_per_prompt, tokenizer_fingerprint_unknown_rate, canonicalizer_mode rollout.

Anika Roy: Add e2e with tokenizer v3.1.1 -> v3.1.2 to assert stable keys when canonicalizer is on.

Maria Chen: Assigned: Maria -> PR, Sasha -> tests, Kevin -> dashboards. ETA: end of day tomorrow for PR w/ basic util. Follow-up sync in #eng-runtime tomorrow 10:30am.

Kevin Patel: :thumbsup:
